column1: # prose-ledger.tsv: every "N bit(s)" figure in README.md, docs/, apps/web/i18n/ and
# apps/web/app/ that does not match docs/SECURITY-LEVELS.md for the regime its line
# names, with why. Read by tools/security-levels/tests/prose.rs; list them all with
# Columns, tab-separated: kind, path, snippet, count, reason. The snippet is a
# substring of the line that CONTAINS the figure(s) the row covers: a row covers
# only the figures inside its snippet, so a figure added to or changed on a listed
# line is not covered by that line's row. "*" instead of a snippet covers every
# unmatched figure of the file, and then needs a count.
#   verified     checked by hand: correct, but the scanner cannot tell which figure of
#                the line belongs to which regime, or it is a parameter
#   historical   a past, withdrawn or superseded figure, described as such
#   external     a figure about something the calculator does not cover (another
#                system, a cipher, a hash the proof system does not use)
#   not-a-level  a width, an entropy or a quoted rule, not a security level
#   v2-candidate a v2 design figure quoted as a candidate
#   stale        FINDING: stated as a current level or parameter, and not what the
#                calculator or the verifier gives. Left for Phase 1 (this run does not
#                edit README, docs or i18n). The number of figures stale rows cover, and
#                the set of stale rows, are pinned exactly in tests/prose.rs.
# A row that covers nothing any more fails the test: delete it when its line is fixed.
